description: Read real authorized Lazada seller orders by creation date through official HMAC-SHA256-signed API, without placing or altering orders. One call costs 0.01 USDC on Base x402; customer-owned provider credentials use X-Provider-Key header where needed.

app_key.description: Customer Lazada application ID; app secret in X-Provider-Key header

created_after.description: Orders created after ISO-8601 date-time with timezone

limit.description: Maximum orders 1–20; seller access token in X-Provider-Token header

region.description: Seller marketplace country MY, SG, TH, ID, PH or VN

name: api_lazada_seller_orders
